source_summary: lakeshorecarbide.com product pages (one page per tool: part number, spec table, description); crawled via sitemap and category navigation. Router-relevant subset: 1-3 flute ball nose, VFA variable-flute aluminium end mills (square, corner radius, rougher/finisher, long reach), 2/3 flute regular/stub/double-end/metric/45-60° helix end mills, drill mills, chamfer tools and tapered engravers. Steel, hard-milling, 4+ flute, roughing, high-feed, thread, back-chamfer, corner-rounding (no cutter diameter) and surplus items left out. VFA chip loads from LakeShore's VFA technical data PDF.
